newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia's food processor gets new DM60 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Croatia's food processor gets new DM60 mln loan.

text.p: Leading Croatian food-processing group Podravka said on Friday it had struck a deal for a 60 million German mark loan from Germany's Bayerische Vereinsbank.
A company official told Reuters by telephone the loan agreement would be signed on July 9 in Zagreb. He could not provide any other details.
Podravka has been swapping its old liabilities, incurred at high interest, for more favourable new loans from Croatian and foreign banks.
It said last week it had won a 20 million mark five-year loan from Bank Austria which would help its financial restructuring efforts.

The company still has to publish consolidated 1996 results, which are said to reflect the poor performance of five loss-making subsidiaries it spun off at the end of last year. But results for the first half of this year are expected to be better.
